name: thrm_c4_squib
description: Thermal igniter squib: 3px THRM column with a 1px C-4 detonator strip beside it, BRCK/IRON casing, WIFI+NSCN trigger tap. Sparking the tap flash-heats whatever touches the squib (used to light a DEUT bed with zero neutrons).
why: Save 199128 (Fully Manual PWR, 89k parts) has 0 NEUT particles anywhere; its DEUT bed is lit purely by this THRM(85)+C-4(35) column at (240-243,194-226) triggered from WIFI ch25 at (239,203) with NSCN under it. Source WIFI is bare inside BRCK (stands at 2274C); here it is INSL-jacketed so it cannot cook the C-4 strip before the trigger fires.
